text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing.metering.europe.token_count deviation in eu-west-1 detected at 03:18Z. Severity: P1. Overflag spike +customer-visible. Paging oncall @ryan

ryan: oncall here, joining. will grab context and call handoff from APAC shift shortly

sarah: I see a big jump in embedding token counts from emitter service deployed ~03:18Z. Some batches look duplicated. Triage in progress.

anjali: support reports 3 EU customers got overage emails, they DM'ed invoices. Sending examples to #support-private.

metrics-bot: quick query: `SELECT sum(tokens) as total FROM metering.events WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '20 minutes'` -> 1,240,112 tokens (baseline ~120k).

mike: pushed emitter v2.3.1 at 03:17Z to eu-west-1 (rollout 50%). Rollback candidate v2.2.9 available.

sarah: pulling emitter logs for duplicate publish pattern to topic `metering-embeds`. Filtered by trace id from invoices.

(sarah): ```
logger.INFO emitter_publish batch_id=ab12cd event_count=512 seq=178 duplicate_key=none
logger.INFO emitter_publish batch_id=ab12cd event_count=512 seq=179 duplicate_key=ab12cd
```

ryan: that duplicate_key looks bad — looks like a retry path that doesn't de-dupe on payload id. Could be a schema change in v2.3.1.

ops-bot: Routing note: traffic routed to 3 instances with v2.3.1. Remaining instances v2.2.x.

anjali: Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) Pause rollout, 2) Flip emitter to shadow-mode for eu-west-1, 3) Roll back to v2.2.9 if necessary, 4) Draft CS note.

mike: pausing rollout now. flipping v2.3.1 hosts to shadow-mode (no writes) -> in progress.

metrics-bot: after flip -> sum(tokens last 5m) = 140k (back near baseline). That's promising.

liz-support: I notified the three customers that we are investigating and put provisional credits on their accounts to avoid immediate billing. Will hold until we confirm root cause.

ryan: good. mike — if shadow-mode holds, let's coordinate rollback for the 3 instances still receiving writes. Can you list affected instance IDs?

mike: affected hosts: eu-w1-em-03, eu-w1-em-07, eu-w1-em-11. Shadow-mode success on 03 & 07, 11 still switching.

(sarah): found the regression: v2.3.1 changed backoff logic so that a failed kafka ack would re-enqueue identical batch with same batch_id but without dedupe header. dedupe relied on header that v2.3.1 omitted for embedded batches.

ryan: can we patch v2.3.1 quickly to include header? Is rollback faster?

mike: rollback to v2.2.9 on affected hosts is fastest. starting rollback on eu-w1-em-11 now.

ops-bot: rollback completed on eu-w1-em-11 at 03:34Z. All active writers in eu-west-1 now on v2.2.9.

metrics-bot: post-rollback check: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'` -> 135k. No further duplicate patterns detected.

anjali: support: keep provisional credits for affected customers for now, asking billing to hold.

liz-support: done. Credits applied, customers notified of provisional refund and follow-up.

ryan: next steps: 1) full audit to identify all customers impacted and token delta, 2) backfill/compensate via ledger correction, 3) postmortem and deploy blocker on emitter v2.3.x until dedupe validated.

(sarah): exporting sample id list for backfill now. Posting to secure drive link. (link omitted)

mike: we will add integration test for dedupe header and a CI check that prevents rolling v2.3.1 without the header.

ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated (writes halted/rollback complete). Monitoring 30m.

metrics-bot: initial impact estimate: ~1.1M tokens duplicated across ~2h window, peak around 03:18-03:22Z. Will produce per-customer deltas in 20m.

anjali: customer-facing note drafted, will coordinate with legal and comms.

ryan: handing off to morning oncall (sarah) for monitoring and follow-up. I'll create pagerduty follow-up ticket and a short war room for postmortem tomorrow 10:00Z.

sarah: ack, taking monitoring. Adding detection rule to alert on duplicate_key anomalies and to block future rollouts automatically.

liz-support: I'll follow up with customers once we have exact deltas. Thanks everyone.

ryan: closing incident channel for now. If anything new pops, ping P0. Good job. :thumbsup:

(sarah): recording notes for postmortem: root cause = emitter v2.3.1 header regression; mitigation = pause+shadow-mode+rollback; customer mitigation = provisional credits + notifications. Postmortem assigned to eng-metrics + emitter team.

ops-bot: incident closed (mitigated) at 03:58Z. Monitoring window open until 04:28Z.
